text: {"label":"Improving Academic Performance in Math and College Courses","definition":"Behavioral interventions to raise student academic outcomes, including math fact fluency, brief experimental analysis, and college course quizzes, grade contingencies, guided notes, and interteaching to improve exam and assignment performance.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Targets measured academic achievement such as quiz scores and math fluency, rather than classroom on-task behavior, named instructional packages like Direct Instruction or precision teaching, or teacher training."}
